description: A project may declare ADRs not yet built in adr.unbuilt; their failing gates are reported, not failed. A passing declared gate, a bad declaration, or a growing hexa list fails the run. Undeclared ADRs are judged as before.

specs.description: The declared reason is carried into the verdict verbatim
specs.then: returns Verdict::Unbuilt { reason: "delegate_scope test not written yet" }

specs.description: A declaration covers only its own id; another entry's reason is never borrowed
specs.then: the verdict is not Verdict::Unbuilt (it is a Fails verdict, as for any undeclared ADR whose gate failed under --ci)

specs.description: Each failing outcome of a declared ADR becomes Unbuilt under --ci
specs.when: judge("ADR-A", o, &unbuilt, true) for each o in [Failed, Unrunnable, CannotRunHere, NotProvenHere]
specs.then: each returns Verdict::Unbuilt { reason: "why" }

specs.description: A declared ADR is reported as unbuilt outside --ci too
specs.then: returns Verdict::Unbuilt { reason: "why" }

specs.description: A declared, still-unbuilt ADR is never counted as passed and never fails --ci
specs.then: the verdict is neither Verdict::Passed nor Verdict::Fails(_)

specs.description: For a declared ADR, every non-passing gate outcome is Unbuilt with the declared reason
specs.given: any adr id, any reason r, any unbuilt map U with U[adr] = r, any ci
specs.when: judge(adr, o, &U, ci) for o in {Failed, Unrunnable, CannotRunHere, NotProvenHere}
specs.then: the result equals Verdict::Unbuilt { reason: r }

specs.description: A declared ADR whose gate passes fails the run and says to remove the declaration
specs.then: returns Verdict::Fails(msg), where msg names adr.unbuilt and tells the user to remove ADR-A from it

specs.description: The list cannot hide a working gate, even outside --ci
specs.then: the verdict is neither Verdict::Passed nor Verdict::Unbuilt { .. }; it is Verdict::Fails(_)

specs.description: A passing gate on a declared ADR always fails
specs.given: any adr, any U containing adr, any ci
specs.then: the result matches Verdict::Fails(_)

specs.description: An id that names no ADR is reported
specs.then: returns exactly one error, which names ADR-0000000000 and says it names no ADR

specs.description: An id that names an ADR with no gate is reported
specs.then: returns exactly one error, which names ADR-B and says it records no gate

specs.description: A valid declaration yields no errors, and an empty one never does
specs.when: declaration_errors is called with {"ADR-A": "x"}, and separately with {}
specs.then: both calls return an empty Vec

specs.description: Exactly the bad ids are reported
specs.given: any unbuilt map U and any gated map G
specs.then: each id in U that is absent from G or has G[id] == false appears in exactly one error; no error names an id with G[id] == true; the result is empty iff every id in U has G[id] == true

specs.description: Undeclared ADRs keep today's verdicts
specs.when: judge is called on ADR-A with (Passed, ci=true), (Failed, ci=true), (NotProvenHere, ci=true), (NotProvenHere, ci=false), and (NoGate, ci=true)
specs.then: the results are, in order: Passed, Fails(_), Fails(_), Unproven, NoGate

specs.description: Declaring other ADRs does not soften an undeclared failure
specs.then: returns Verdict::Fails(_), not Verdict::Unbuilt

specs.description: The declaration has no effect on an ADR outside it
specs.given: any adr, any outcome o, any ci, any map U that does not contain adr
specs.when: judge(adr, &o, &U, ci) is compared with judge(adr, &o, &Unbuilt::new(), ci)
specs.then: the two results are equal, and neither is Verdict::Unbuilt

specs.description: hexa's own list holds at most the two named ADRs
specs.then: it passes: the list has at most 2 entries, and each key is ADR-2610161730 or ADR-2610221834

specs.description: A new entry fails the ledger test
specs.given: hexa's adr.unbuilt with a third id added (for example ADR-2610271110)
specs.then: it fails and names the id that was added

specs.description: Removing a built decision is allowed
specs.given: hexa's adr.unbuilt with ADR-2610221834 removed, leaving only ADR-2610161730
specs.then: it passes

specs.description: The judgement works from its arguments alone
specs.given: a working directory with no .hexa/project.json and no ADR files
specs.when: judge("ADR-X", &Outcome::Failed, &{"ADR-X": "r"}, true) and declaration_errors(&{"ADR-X": "r"}, &{"ADR-X": true}) are called
specs.then: they return Unbuilt { reason: "r" } and an empty Vec respectively, with no I/O and no gate executed

specs.description: judge does not run the gate itself or look ADRs up
specs.given: an adr id that names no ADR on disk, outcome Passed, empty unbuilt
specs.then: returns Verdict::Passed, decided only from the outcome given; no command is run and no file is read

specs.description: Both functions are deterministic
specs.when: judge and declaration_errors are each called twice with the same arguments
specs.then: each pair of results is equal
